name: max-network
description: Hosted MCP servers bundled with skills: legal research from primary law, chess with an engine coach, a clinical scribe, code reuse with DRY.codes, and a PDF librarian with DRYPDF.

plugins.name: legal-research
plugins.description: Multi-jurisdiction legal research and the AI patient-rights advocate.

plugins.name: chess
plugins.description: Real-time chess: a shared lobby and live games, playable from any MCP client.

plugins.name: scribe
plugins.description: Turns a clinical narrative or a clinical document into FHIR R4 resources, validated against their IPS profiles with codes checked against a terminology server.

plugins.name: dry-codes
plugins.description: Reuse before you write. Indexes your code and docs, then finds them by text and by meaning so an agent reuses what exists instead of regenerating it, and catches near-duplicates before they land.

plugins.name: drypdf
plugins.description: A librarian for your PDFs. Search, read, upload and organize stored documents, grounded in their actual text, from any agent.
